subject: [inla] useful new argument when doing prediction

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: [inla] useful new argument when doing prediction
parts:
We have added a new argument 'link' in the 'control.predictor'-list to
compute fitted values for predictions with the link-function from the
likelihood, more easily.

The FAQ entry is updated:

http://www.r-inla.org/faq#TOC-How-can-I-do-predictions-using-INLA-

You'll need the testing-version of today to enable this feature.

See also

?control.predictor

and the argument 'link'.


Best
H
